notes.title: Well, a bit late update...
notes.notes:
Hi guys. It's been a long time since the game was updated and fixed. The last time I messed up with starting values when was tweaking late-game progression. I am sorry, I didn't have a time to check the game for a lot of time :(

Here is a list of fixes:
[list]
[*] Changed offline progression, now it's fully offline, no more connections to server (Server is not really stable). (It is possible to cheat the time now)
[*] Everything should be resetting correctly now when prestiging
[*] Settings Menu is no longer appearing at the start of a game
[*] Quit button is now working as intended
[*] Fixed Blood Magic Panel not showing the correct Total Bonus values when you have 0 Mega Sacrifices
[*] Fixed some 4:3, 16:10 and 5:4 resolution UI bugs
[*] Fixed the problem when Clicker ability was not working when you are at 0 mana
[/list]

The game [strike]*SHOULD* be[/strike] now in a playable state. I checked thrice before pushing this update to live. Sorry for making such an ill-conceived balance "fixes". I hope everything is going correctly now. If not, just comment here what's wrong and I will try to fix ASAP.

Build ID: [u][b]3859613[/b][/u]

[h1]If the game doesn't want to update:[/h1] 
In the steam client, right click on the game in your library list, select properties from the dropdown list, then in the Local files tab select Verify integrity of game cache.

notes.title: Update .10
notes.notes:
Good night everyone! Balance changes and cool improvements are here. Thank you all for your suggestions!

[h1]What's new:[/h1]

[*] Reworked Shop UI
[*] Reworked Chests UI
[*] Cached all big equations to reduce CPU usage (My CPU usage went down by almost 3%, I hope it will work for everyone)
[*] Removed limits from some bonuses at Chests. "Starting level" bonus max level depends now on your max level reached divided by 2
[*] Reworked buildings buff formulas (It will be tough now to get to 100%)
[*] Increased building caps: Weaponry, Treasury - 1000, Armory - 175
[*] Reworked multiplier gained with item amount (Probably will add a progress bar that will show amount till next buff. (good or no?))
[*] Added custom amount to buy at Blood Magic. To activate just do SHIFT-CTRL-Click. Thanks
[*] Added label showing total bonus for Training at Blood Magic
[*] Added option to disable auto chest opening (Settings panel)
[*] Added option to remove all Training bonuses in Settings (Just for 1337 Achievement)
[*] Max level reached will no more reset after prestige
[*] Shift-Click now skips 10 levels and Ctrl-Click skips 100 levels

[h1]If the game doesn't want to update:[/h1]

notes.title: [IMPORTANT] IF YOU LOST YOUR SAVE
notes.notes:
So, guys, there were a few save loses due to the electricity problems and incorrect game shutdowns. When this happens, your save file fills with NULLS and I can't do [b]ANYTHING[/b] with this, BUT I have made a [b]backup[/b] system.

[h1]Explanation:[/h1]
So, first of all, this thing was implemented in build [b]3229378[/b] and if you lost your save before this build, I am really sorry about this, but it is impossible to restore any data... This system makes backups up to 3 minutes back in time. This was made just to be sure, that one of these saves will definitely work.

[h1]How to restore:[/h1] (For Windows. Can't really make a good guide for Linux)
[olist]
[*]Close your game
[*]Open File [b]Explorer/Windows Explorer[b]
[*]Type [b]%AppData%[/b] into the address bar and hit enter
[*]Navigate back to [b]AppData[/b] folder
[*]Navigate to [b]LocalLow -> SaFiKiK -> Idle Hunter[/b]
[*]You will find there the list of [b].OLD[/b] files called [b]AdvancedPlayerPrefs[x][/b] where [b][x][/b] is the amount of seconds elapsed after the save. Delete the [b]AdvancedPlayerPrefs.txt[/b] file (IMPORTANT: [b].txt[/b])
[*]Choose one of the backup files you want to restore from and rename it to [b]AdvancedPlayerPrefs.txt[/b]
[*]Done. Now you can launch the game
[/olist]
